blocks.text: They rowed towards the Charco channel, the *gola* where the Mar Menor opens into the Mediterranean. Andrés had known those channels since he was a boy. blocks.text: "At the archive," she said, "there was a word that stuck with me. Unstoppable. A president said it thirty-five years ago, talking about something he didn't yet fully know. He was talking about you, Mum, though he didn't know it. About us."

blocks.text: "What?"

blocks.text: Aya searched for the word, the way she searched for important words, without hurrying.

blocks.text: "Free," she said at last. "Like the wind over the water. Like the water through the channel. Not because no one can stop me, but because, even if they could, I'd go on choosing the same thing."
